name: commentkeyword
description: Create and manage Instagram comment-to-DM keyword automations in CommentKeyword.
long_description:
Set up an Instagram "Comment GUIDE and I'll DM you the link" automation from your AI agent. The server creates, re-targets, pauses and deletes keyword automations through the CommentKeyword API, and can attach an AI agent you already set up in the dashboard.

You need a CommentKeyword account (the Free plan works) with an Instagram professional account connected, and an API token from Settings → API (https://commentkeyword.com/settings?tab=api) with `keywords:read`, `keywords:write` and `agents:read`. Add `keywords:delete` only if you want the agent to be able to delete automations.

The server only talks to https://commentkeyword.com/api and stores nothing on disk. Every automation messages real people, so the tools tell the agent to confirm the keyword, the DM and the target with you first.

tools.name: list_keywords
tools.description: List the comment-keyword automations in the workspace, newest first.

tools.name: get_keyword
tools.description: Get one keyword automation, including whether it is still waiting for the next post.

tools.name: create_keyword
tools.description: Create a comment-to-DM automation for the next post, all posts or specific posts.

tools.name: update_keyword
tools.description: Change a keyword automation: re-target it, edit the DM, or pause it.

tools.name: delete_keyword
tools.description: Permanently delete a keyword automation (asks for confirmation when an AI agent is attached).

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List the AI agents set up in the dashboard, to attach one to a keyword.

api_token.title: CommentKeyword API token
api_token.description: Create one at https://commentkeyword.com/settings?tab=api with keywords:read, keywords:write and agents:read.
